article.headline: Will Smith scores to lead Sharks past Blackhawks 3-2
article.description: — Will Smith earned his 100th NHL point with a third-period goal, and the San Jose Sharks beat the Chicago Blackhawks 3-2 on Tuesday night.
article.linkText: Will Smith scores to lead Sharks past Blackhawks 3-2

images.name: Chicago Blackhawks vs. San Jose Sharks: Game Highlights
images.caption: Chicago Blackhawks vs. San Jose Sharks: Game Highlights

article.story: SAN JOSE, Calif. -- — Will Smith earned his 100th NHL point with a third-period goal, and the San Jose Sharks beat the Chicago Blackhawks 3-2 on Tuesday night. Smith scored the winning goal on a wrist shot 3:28 into the third, assisted by Collin Graf and Macklin Celebrini, putting the Sharks on top 3-1. William Eklund had a goal and assist and Kiefer Sherwood also scored for the Sharks. Ryan Donato and Frank Nazar each scored for the Blackhawks. Connor Bedard earned his 200th career point with an assist on Donato’s first-period goal. Bedard has four assists in his last three games. Alex Nedeljkovic stopped 27 shots in the win for the Sharks. Spencer Knight had 20 saves for the Blackhawks. The Sharks won 69.2% of the faceoffs in the game. Up next Blackhawks: Host the Carolina Hurricanes on Thursday. Sharks: Host the Edmonton Oilers on Wednesday. ------ AP NHL: https://apnews.com/hub/nhl ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
